svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, per supply (860 W at 200-240 VAC and 240 VDC, 800 W at 100-127 VAC)
svg.data-fans: five 40 x 40 x 56 mm counter-rotating PWM fans, with space for a sixth
svg.data-cpu: one 4th or 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processor, socket E (LGA-4677), up to 300 W TDP
svg.data-memory: 8 DDR5 DIMM slots, up to 2 TB of 5600 MT/s ECC RDIMM
svg.data-storage-controller: onboard SATA, 6 Gbps; NVMe and SAS need the optional cables or controller card
svg.data-regulatory: FCC, ICES, CE, UKCA, VCCI, RCM, NRTL, CB

circle.data-states: off overheat fan-fail power-fail uid-local uid-remote bmc-reset
circle.data-description: Information LED. Solid red - overheat; red 1 Hz - fan failure; red 0.25 Hz - power failure; solid blue - UID activated locally; blue 1 Hz - UID activated from the BMC; blue 2 Hz - BMC resetting. Also: red solid with the power LED blinking green - fault; blue and red at 10 Hz - recovery mode; blue 4 Hz - BMC setting factory defaults; blue 10 Hz with the power LED blinking green - BMC or BIOS firmware updating.
NIC2 LED. Flashing - network activity on LAN2. Colour and rate are not stated; drawn green at 4 Hz.
NIC1 LED. Flashing - network activity on LAN1. Colour and rate are not stated; drawn green at 4 Hz.
HDD LED. Flashing - activity on the storage drives. Colour and rate are not stated; drawn amber at 4 Hz.

Power LED. Steady on - power on; blinking at 4 Hz - checking BIOS/BMC integrity. Also 4 Hz with the information LED blue - BIOS firmware updating; two blinks and a pause - BMC firmware updating; 1 Hz with the information LED red - fault detected. The colour is not stated in the table; drawn green.

g.data-description: UID button. Turns the blue UID indicators on at the front and the rear; also resets the BMC (manual section 7.8).

circle.data-description: the UID lamp in the button. Blue when the unit identifier is activated.
Power button. Applies or removes primary power, standby power stays; hold four seconds to force a shutdown.

g.data-description: the six USB Type-A ports: two USB 3.2 Gen1 at the front, two USB 2.0 and two USB 3.2 Gen1 at the rear
g.title: usb-front-1

g.data-description: the six USB Type-A ports: two USB 3.2 Gen1 at the front, two USB 2.0 and two USB 3.2 Gen1 at the rear
g.title: usb-front-2

circle.data-description: Activity. Solid blue - idle SAS drive installed; blinking blue - I/O activity; off - idle SATA drive or no drive. The blink rate is not stated and is drawn at 4 Hz.

circle.data-states: off fault rebuild identify safe-to-remove do-not-remove
circle.data-description: Status. Solid red - drive failure; red 1 Hz - rebuild; red 4 Hz - identify (each with VROC support); solid green - safe to remove an NVMe device; amber 1 Hz - do not remove an NVMe device. The hot-spare and power-on patterns are not drawn.
